terminals.name: memory-core
terminals.command: source .cursor/env.sh && cd MemoryCore && export TDAI_GATEWAY_CONFIG="$PWD/tdai-gateway.standalone.yaml" && exec node --import tsx src/gateway/server.ts

terminals.name: memory-knowledge
terminals.command: source .cursor/env.sh && cd MemoryKnowledge && exec pnpm dev

terminals.name: memory-proxy
terminals.command: source .cursor/env.sh && cd MemoryProxy && exec npm run start:config

terminals.name: memory-panel
terminals.command: source .cursor/env.sh && cd MemoryPanel && exec pnpm dev

terminals.name: panel-web
terminals.command: source .cursor/env.sh && cd MemoryPanel/web && exec npm run dev
